remarks: Welcome to your new home! This delightful 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom townhouse is a blend of modern comfort and classic charm, perfectly situated in a sought-after neighborhood.  Step inside to discover a bright and airy open-concept living space designed for both relaxation and entertainment. The spacious living room features 9 ft ceiling and large windows that flood the area with natural light, while the contemporary design and neutral color palette create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The heart of the home is the well-appointed kitchen, complete with sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinet space, and extra custom cabinetry. Whether you're preparing a gourmet meal or a quick breakfast, this kitchen will cater to all your culinary needs. Adjacent to the kitchen is a cozy dining area, perfect for entertaining guests. Upstairs, you'll find 2 bedrooms each with en suite featuring tiled showers, and laundry. The 3rd floor has a primary suite, a true retreat featuring a generous walk-in closet and an ensuite bathroom.  Off the kitchen, the exterior patio and green space is a perfect sanctuary for relaxing at the end of the day. Ainslie square community boasts an array of exceptional amenities, including a heated in-ground pool for year-round enjoyment. Residents can also take advantage of a stunning clubhouse featuring a well-equipped kitchen, cozy fireplace, and a spacious gym, playground and grills!
